bug_semantics: Fluentd's out_http plugin treats the configured endpoint as a placeholder template. At flush time parse_endpoint calls extract_placeholders(@endpoint, chunk) and then URI.parse on the result with no hostname check, so an attacker-controlled tag (or other placeholder) can rewrite the host of the outbound POST/PUT (e.g. endpoint http://${tag}/path to 169.254.169.254 or an internal service). CWE-918 SSRF; patched by requiring allowed_hosts whenever the expanded host differs from the configured host.
flaw_origin: The unvalidated expand-then-parse path was first written when Masahiro Nakagawa added the in-tree http output plugin on 2019-07-10: parse_endpoint in lib/fluent/plugin/out_http.rb already did extract_placeholders(@endpoint, chunk); URI.parse(endpoint). extract_placeholders already substituted ${tag} in lib/fluent/plugin/output.rb at that parent. The plugin landed via merge PR #2488 (3d96b15c) in v1.7.0.rc1/v1.7.0 and the mechanism was unchanged through v1.19.2; a 2020 whitespace trim on the extract_placeholders line is not a first-write.
